dict.string: DEUS requires camera access to scan government-issued IDs and complete identity verification (KYC).
DEUS uses Face ID to securely authenticate and authorize financial transactions.
DEUS requires photo library access to upload identity documents and verification proofs.
DEUS needs permission to save generated transaction receipts to your photo library.
DEUS uses Bluetooth to connect with authorized payment card readers.
DEUS uses Bluetooth to communicate with payment terminals.
DEUS verifies device location to ensure point-of-sale card transactions comply with financial regulations.
